kind: external Relay URL validation with loopback forwarding as a public-network stand-in

setup.relay: the Relay fixture started as a standalone process on the host at 127.0.0.1:18080 with deployment env knobs (MH_RELAY_PORT, MH_RELAY_OWNER_LOGIN)
setup.deviceView: the owner device reaches it as http://127.0.0.1:19769 through an hdc rport, standing in for a public HTTPS URL
setup.hostCalls: the test host calls the same Relay at http://127.0.0.1:18080

crossDeviceAttempt.outcome: the second device rendered the shared session over the external Relay URL, but the owner stop returned relay:unreachable over the loopback rport; the direct-network deployment is expected to avoid that transport artifact

verified: the acceptance test can run against an externally started Relay through --relay-url/--relay-call-url instead of spawning the fixture
owner ArkWeb login, share creation, second source, reconnect, reader checks, live revocation, stop and gateway shutdown pass in external mode
the second-device viewer renders the shared session from the external URL
the deployment env knobs (host/port, tokens, owner-login mode, login redirect, viewer config file) are supported by the Relay fixture
